notes.title: Demo Update (ver 3.2)
notes.content:
The demo has been updated to ver 3.3. Please check the version display on the title screen when launching the game.

From ver 3.3, update details can now be viewed from within the game.

Changes:
- Added semi-auto lock-on system
- Added a tutorial for switching lock-on modes
- HUD now always displays weapon reload status
- Adjusted impact effects
- Added an update log

notes.title: Demo Update (ver 3.2)
notes.content:
On September 24th, the demo version was updated to ver 3.2. Please check the version display on the title screen when launching the game.

Additionally, we have prepared a Google Form as a means of providing feedback. You can access the form from within the game to report bugs or submit requests.

Changes:
- Lock-on system has been modified
- Ability to move backward during BI has been added
- A feedback link has been added to the main menu

notes.title: January 2024: Progress Update
notes.content:
This is developer RRR. 
Thank you for all the wishlist registrations and playtest feedback.

Our game opened its store page in July 2023 and has been releasing playtest versions since August. Currently, we have almost finished building the foundational systems and have entered the mass production phase, expanding missions, arenas, and mech parts. We aim to release the game within 2024, so please stay tuned for a little while longer.

Additionally, we are publishing the game’s development process through videos. If you’re curious about the progress, please feel free to check them out. 

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@RRR_VersionThree/videos
